meta.title: ERP Consultant: Independent ERP Selection Services | Cyrrus
meta.description: Independent ERP consulting and selection: we define requirements, evaluate vendors, and choose the ERP that fits your processes. 100% vendor-agnostic.

hero.title: Independent ERP consultant: vendor-neutral ERP selection
hero.description: Choosing an ERP isn't choosing software. It's choosing how your company will run for the next several years. We help organizations define, evaluate, and select the ERP that best fits their processes, objectives, architecture, and investment capacity.

respuesta.title: What does an independent ERP consultant do?
respuesta.body: An independent ERP consultant helps a company decide which ERP it needs before signing with a vendor or an implementation partner. At Cyrrus that decision is made with criteria defined from your operations: we have no commercial alliances or commissions with any ERP vendor, and the recommendation can be to switch platforms, optimize the current one, or not change at all.

items.title: Selection
items.description: Gathers requirements, builds the longlist and shortlist, runs the RFI/RFP and the demos, and compares vendors against six criteria and the total cost of ownership.

items.title: Timeline
items.description: As a reference, the Identify phase of the CIRA Method usually takes 6 to 12 weeks, from the strategic kickoff to support during contracting.

items.title: Implementation
items.description: Selection and implementation are separate phases. During the implementation of the recommended ERP we can act as an external PMO that governs schedule, risks, and vendors.

items.title: Business growth

items.title: Disconnected systems

items.title: Manual processes

items.title: Poor financial visibility

dolor.narrativa: The ERP that worked when the company was smaller can become a constraint once the organization grows.

problemaReal.title: Deciding to change ERPs is easy. Picking the right one is hard.
problemaReal.body: SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, NetSuite, and many other platforms can solve similar problems from different angles.

faq.question: When should a company hire an ERP consultant?
faq.answer: When the company has grown faster than its platform, runs systems that don't talk to each other, depends on parallel spreadsheets, takes weeks to consolidate its financial information, its ERP no longer gets real support, or it is about to expand into new units or countries. Also before renewing or extending the current ERP: sometimes the answer is to optimize, not replace.

faq.question: How long does an ERP selection process take?
faq.answer: As a reference, the CIRA method's Identify phase typically takes 6 to 12 weeks, from the strategic kickoff through contracting support.

faq.question: How do we know if the ERP we already have is the right one for the company?
faq.answer: We evaluate your current platform against the same six objective criteria, even if changing vendors isn't on the table — sometimes the answer is to optimize, not replace.

faq.question: How much does an ERP selection process cost?
faq.answer: Cost depends on scope and organization size, not on a list price. What stays constant is the ratio: selection advisory costs a fraction of the ERP license plus implementation, and its job is to keep that far larger investment from landing on the wrong platform. It is defined with you before starting, with fixed scope and deliverables.

faq.question: What criteria are used to evaluate an ERP?
faq.answer: We evaluate against six objective criteria, defined before looking at any brand: functional fit to your real processes, technical viability on your current infrastructure, five-year total cost of ownership (not just the license), vendor strength and experience in your industry, your team's capacity to adopt it, and the long-term sustainability of the product and its roadmap.

faq.question: Why hire an independent consultant instead of going straight to the ERP vendor?
faq.answer: Because a vendor has one product to sell and their evaluation may end at that product. Cyrrus holds no commercial alliances or commissions with any ERP manufacturer: the criteria come from your operation, not from a catalog, and the outcome may well be that the best decision is not to change platforms at all.

faq.question: Do you help select an ERP for companies in Colombia or LATAM?
faq.answer: Yes. We work with organizations across Colombia and the rest of LATAM, using the same six-criteria evaluation process and no commercial alliances that would bias the recommendation toward a particular local or regional vendor.

faq.question: Does ERP selection include managing the implementation project?
faq.answer: Those are two separate phases of the CIRA Method. If needed, we also act as an external PMO during the implementation of the recommended ERP, with the same real accountability for the outcome that we apply during selection.

faq.question: What is an HCM, and how is it different from payroll software?
faq.answer: An HCM (Human Capital Management) is the platform that covers the whole people-management cycle: payroll, recruiting, talent, performance, and employee experience. Payroll software solves only one part, calculating and paying payroll. Choosing between them depends on the size of the organization and which people processes it needs to integrate.

faq.question: When should a company hire an HCM consultant?
faq.answer: When payroll, talent, and recruiting live on separate platforms that don't connect, when vacation, reviews, and compensation are managed in spreadsheets, or when the current platform can't support headcount growth or operations in new countries.

faq.question: How long does an HCM selection process take?
faq.answer: As a reference, the CIRA method's Identify phase typically takes 6 to 12 weeks, from the strategic kickoff through contracting support.

faq.question: We operate in several countries — how does that affect the selection?
faq.answer: Regulatory and payroll compliance per country is one of the six criteria we evaluate from the start — not an adjustment made after the selection.

faq.question: How much does an HCM selection process cost?
faq.answer: It depends on headcount, on how many countries you operate in, and on whether payroll is in scope. As in any selection, advisory costs a fraction of the license plus implementation, and exists to protect that larger investment.

faq.question: What criteria are used to evaluate an HCM?
faq.answer: Regulatory and payroll compliance in every country you operate in, fit to your talent and development processes, employee self-service experience, integration with the financial ERP, total cost per employee, and the vendor's ability to keep up with labor law changes.

faq.question: Why use an independent consultant to choose an HCM?
faq.answer: Because in payroll a mistake can be costly, and a vendor may have little incentive to point out its own country-level gaps. An evaluator with no commission can tell you which platform does not properly cover your local legislation.

respuesta.title: What does an independent HCM consultant do?

At Cyrrus that decision starts from your people-management model: we have no commercial alliances or commissions with HCM vendors, so we can tell you which platform does not properly cover your local legislation.

hero.description: Asset management starts long before maintenance. It starts with choosing the right technology. We help organizations define, evaluate, and select the EAM that best fits their operational reality.

dolor.title: When assets become a source of uncertainty

items.title: Reactive maintenance
items.description: Assets get serviced after they've already failed, not before.

items.title: Scattered information
items.description: Maintenance history lives in physical logs or loose files.

items.title: Assets without traceability

items.title: Costs hard to control
items.description: Maintenance and spare-parts spending can't be accurately attributed.

items.title: Unplanned downtime

items.title: Disconnected spare-parts inventory

problemaReal.title: An EAM has to fit the operational reality of the assets
problemaReal.body: The need for an EAM looks different in manufacturing, energy, utilities, infrastructure, mining, transportation, or oil & gas.
problemaReal.punch: The EAM with the most features isn't necessarily the best EAM for a given organization.

faq.question: When should a company hire an EAM consultant?
faq.answer: When maintenance is reactive and assets get serviced after they've already failed, when maintenance history lives in physical logs or loose files, when there's unplanned downtime with no prior warning, or when procurement doesn't know what parts are available before issuing an order.

faq.question: What's the difference between a CMMS and an EAM?
faq.answer: A CMMS manages maintenance tasks: work orders, spare parts, and scheduling. An EAM covers the asset's whole lifecycle, including capital planning, risk, and performance. We explain it in more detail in our CMMS and EAM software guide.

faq.question: How long does an EAM selection process take?
faq.answer: As a reference, the CIRA method's Identify phase typically takes 6 to 12 weeks, from the strategic kickoff through contracting support.

faq.question: Does the evaluation account for my operation's specific industry?
faq.answer: Yes — the Vendor criterion includes evaluating real experience in industries like manufacturing, energy, mining, or transportation, not just generic platform capability.

faq.question: How much does an EAM selection process cost?
faq.answer: It is defined by the size of the asset base, the number of plants or sites, and maintenance complexity. Advisory costs a fraction of the license plus implementation, and keeps that investment from landing on a platform your operation cannot sustain.

faq.question: What criteria are used to evaluate an EAM?
faq.answer: Coverage of the maintenance cycle you actually run (preventive, predictive, corrective), field and offline capability, integration with the ERP and with sensors or SCADA, vendor experience in your specific industry, total cost of ownership, and ease of adoption by plant personnel.

faq.question: Why hire an independent consultant to choose an EAM?
faq.answer: Because in asset management the gap between what a demo promises and what the operation supports in the field can be wide. With no commission from any manufacturer, we evaluate that gap against criteria defined before seeing any product.

respuesta.title: What does an independent EAM consultant do?
respuesta.body: They help the company decide which maintenance and asset management software it needs — a CMMS, an EAM, or the ERP's maintenance module — before signing with a vendor. At Cyrrus that decision starts from your assets' operational reality, with criteria defined before seeing any product and no manufacturer commissions.
